newsitem.title: USA: U.S. 3-, 6-MO BILLS RATE SEEN AT 5.32 AND 5.45 PCT.
newsitem.headline: U.S. 3-, 6-MO BILLS RATE SEEN AT 5.32 AND 5.45 PCT.

text.p: The U.S. Treasury's sale of $17.0 billion in three- and six-month bills on Monday was expected to garner discount rates of 5.32 and 5.45 percent, respectively, market participants said.
In when-issued trade at about 1250 EDT/1640 GMT, the three-month bill rate was quoted at 5.316 percent while the six-month bill was at 5.441 percent.
The bidding deadline for the auction is 1300 EDT/1700 GMT. Results are expected around 1345 EDT/1745 GMT.
